observer.semantics: Native tick-start memberships integrated over actual dt, matching the original ledger. Phase is tick-start physical stop/speed plus original service-ready and actual command time; traffic_or_other includes protected and post-command dwell. Visits own the following road segment. ID changes are observed native-tick exchanges; no causal holding effect is inferred.

accounting.semantics: W and R are the unchanged native passenger ledger integrals; G=2W+R, in passenger-seconds. Full-day accounts include the common prefix. Root receiver riders, diagnostic target and all other departed passengers are disjoint. Native endpoint membership and ledger endpoint counts are reported separately. Phase costs are descriptive subdivisions already included in R and are never added again. Incomplete passengers retain all cost accrued through the actual endpoint.

nominal_reproduction.semantics: Full parent+low JSON records equal across different fork boundaries; cumulative passenger/visit and observer accounting exact. No learner, optimizer, update-log or policy-equivalence claim.
